title: Complete Erdős Problem #1092: Chromatic Decomposition Threshold (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.formal: f_2(n) = \max\{m: \text{removing} \le m \text{ edges from every subgraph keeps } \chi \le 2,\ \text{yet } \chi(G)\le 3\};\ f_2(n) \gg n?
problemStatement.plain: Let f_r(n) be max edges removable from each subgraph to reduce chromatic number to ≤ r while forcing χ(G) ≤ r+1. Is f₂(n) ≫ n? Rödl (1982) gives f₂(n) = O(n·polylog). Open.
whyMatters: Quantifies how far a graph can be from bipartite while remaining locally 2-degenerate in chromatic terms.
